feat(mysql): parse ASCII and UNICODE. (#8561)

While depreciated for many releases, MySQL 26 still allows a column to
be defined as `VARCHAR(25) ASCII`, which is shorthand for `CHARACTER SET
latin1`.  Similarly, `UNICODE` becomes `ucs2`.
